question: In heldout-deposit-questionnaire.docx, which years and percentage options appear in the table headed 'Targets for the minimum proportion (%) of drinks containers collected for reuse'? Does that table specify an adopted percentage for each year or contain completed choices? Cite its evidence and distinguish proposed options from adopted targets.

facts: Paragraph 9 asks whether reuse targets should be set for DMOs in 2031, 2035, and 2040; it is a consultation question.
Table 0 row 1 has three target-year columns: 2031, 2035, 2040.
Table 0 rows 2-7 list percentage options: 5%, 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%. Rows 8-9 offer Other (free text) and Don't know.
Every year-choice intersection in rows 2-9 is blank or non-breaking whitespace. No chosen or adopted percentage-per-year mapping appears in this table.

successCriteria: List all three years and all six percentage options, plus Other/free text and Don't know.
Explain that the table is an uncompleted consultation choice matrix. Do not map successive percentages onto successive years, treat all options as targets, or claim adopted policy.

Support the table-specific absence of selections with the complete relevant matrix. If provider extraction loses empty cells or column relationships, state that limitation instead of presenting an unsupported complete-table read.
